name: The Midnight Trooper
source:
A short kinetic novel based on the gothic short story, "The Legend of Sleepy Hollow" that focuses on the encounter between Ichabod Crane and the Headless Horseman.

[Edited from [url=https://vaequestproductions.itch.io/the-midnight-trooper]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部改编自哥特短篇小说《睡谷的传说》的短篇电子小说，聚焦于伊卡博德·克莱恩与无头骑士之间的惊魂邂逅。

[摘自[url=https://vaequestproductions.itch.io/the-midnight-trooper]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
